notes.title: Surprise! Ritual: Crown of Horns just got a huge update
notes.notes:
Fellow undead gunslingers,

You will be pleased to hear that Draw Distance has just deployed patch 1.0.3, which comes with an entirely new game mode to spice up the replayability of Ritual: Crown of Horns. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34944645/39758a24973db3e87269c93e7b57366c30484296.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34944645/38c260104851fcaf5b7a9eac877233936e1be542.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34944645/9bac3da566f392d43378da26c3bdc4092833fff2.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34944645/2c0a00d04202979f5a9f0a07c70a71e641d0d5d7.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34944645/012fb895958208ee3c7665d15df76d80b71d7347.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34944645/c3997444be85b49751d91f760a13ba13645951dd.jpg

Screenshots from the update, click on the thumbnails to see — notice anything new ;) ?

Here's a message from the developers to let you know what this update is about:


Message from the developers:  The update is directly connected with the Real-World Data technology we have implemented into the game. The update is quite significant, as it adds a new game mode: Daily Dare, available in The Bloody Heartlands (the HUB) at the Trickstress. 

Everyday, based on the real-world data a new powerful challenge will be generated: three random maps from the game with a special modifier, which significantly increases the difficulty level. Players, who complete the challenge will unlock new powerful items. 

That's what the Trickstress herself has to say about that: "The stars turn and the time presents itself. Every month, depending on the current tropical sun sign, a new selection of WORDS starts to influence the fates of us all. Every day, the WORDS resonate with our world in a more or less significant way, covertly deciding what adventures and difficulties you might encounter. Return every day to face new Dares and collect all of the mystical items awaiting you in the other WORLDS." 

The update adds 6 modifiers increasing the difficulty level and 16 new items!



Ritual Crown of Horns version 1.0.3 patch notes:

- new game mode: Daily Dare
- six modifiers:
[olist]
More enemies on the map
Less Health Points
Slower pace of protagonist's movement
Slower gun reload rate
Spells are more expesive to cast
Lower maximum number of obtainable souls
[/olist]

- 16 new awards / items:

Wormhole Necklet

notes.title: One Shell Straight to Hell release date reveal!
notes.notes:
Dear Brothers and Sisters, your one and only Padre Alexander is coming back in One Shell Straight To Hell on February 9, 2021! 

That’s right, Padre Alexander is back, heavily armed to fight off hordes of demons while doing his best to help the Halliwell family. Join the fight in One Shell Straight To Hell, the isometric, dungeon-crawling roguelike shooter. 

One Shell Straight To Hell will descend you into ever-changing dungeons that overflow with demonic enemies and put your insane skills and over the top weapons to the test against the satanic hordes. To survive you must shout orders to your allies, lay your traps, and raise your gun to lay waste to your enemies. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1330370/One_Shell_Straight_to_Hell/

 Key Features: 

Perplexing monsters- Ranging from the possessed kitchen drawer to drunken long-dead pirate captains and... I almost forgot, demons... a lot of demons.
Regular weapons using a variety of ammunition, holy weapons drawing on your faith, and unholy weapons craving for your blood.
Skill tree that makes you stronger and adds to the strategy.
Base building... at least kind of. You will be able to build small factories to prepare...
Traps for your enemies.
Global enchantments
Power-ups
Randomly generated ‘dungeon’ maps
And some more crazy absurd stuff!


Take a look at the newest trailer of One Shell Straight To Hell:  
[previewyoutube=PZkPm87qP6o;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: DARQ’s Complete Edition release date confirmed
notes.notes:
Hello gunslingers, DARQ’s Complete Edition release date has been confirmed!

On the 4th of December 2020, our friendly dev team Unfold Games will be releasing a new FREE DLC called The Crypt for their award-winning game - DARQ. On the same day, DARQ: Complete Edition will be released on consoles. 

DARQ: Complete Edition will come out with two DLCs included - The Tower, which has been already released on PC, and the aforementioned new DLC - The Crypt.

DARQ: Complete Edition will be available on the following platforms: 

 PC
 Xbox One
 PlayStation 4
 Nintendo Switch - Early 2021
 Xbox Series X|S, PS5 will receive a FREE UPGRADE in early 2021


Let us tell you a little bit more about DARQ, in case you are not familiar with it.

A sleeping boy, Lloyd, becomes aware of being experiencing a dream. That dream quickly changes into a nightmare which haunts him over and over again. Your mission is to help him end these dreams by solving puzzles, defying gravity and keeping an open mind. But be careful! The gloomy, abstract world is filled with creepy creatures lurking in the corners.

Find out more and grab free digital gifts about DARQ here:
[url=]https://www.feardemic-games.com/darq

If you can't wait for the Complete Edition, dive straight into Lloyd’s lucid dreams on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/433550/DARQ/ 

Join Lloyd and help him wake up!

notes.title: Ritual Crown of Horns – Patch 1.0.2 and other news
notes.notes:
Howdy undead gunslingers! A lot is happening on our end but before I go into details I wanted to thank all of you for supporting Ritual: Crown of Horns! Your legend will be preserved by the test of time and your names will be carved forever in our hearts.

And now onwards to the news!

 I. Patch 1.0.2 - Rebalancing 
We’ll be rolling out Patch 1.0.2 later today. We’ve heard you and we’ve read the reviews – you think the game is a wee bit too challenging, so we’re bringing some balancing to the game, to make it more fair, less intimidating and generally more approachable. Don’t get us wrong though, the game is still meant to be a challenge 😊 

PATCH LIST

 ITEMS 
  We’ve buffed weapons. Colt 18XX, 18XX Sharps Rifle, Pump-Action Shotgun, Long Barrelled Shotgun, Crossbow, Zhuge Crossbow, Butterfly Killer – they all underwent changes to make all of the weapons viable in combat and be as deadly as any other.
 We’ve buffed spells. Rusted Sawblades, Sign of Triquetra, Dead Soul, Vengeful Gatling, Wisconsin Death Drives – again, the changes are meant to increase the overall power and usability in combat.
 We’ve buffed items. Oriental Dreamcatcher, Cape of a King, Miniature Labirynth, Ring O' Roadagain, Abandoned Fangs of Triumph, Crocodile Alligator Skin, Brown Grizzly Fur, Ring of Providence, Black and Blue Ring, Ring of a Scumbag. Now they will have a bigger impact on the game. 

BOSS BATTLES
  -	Waltham Arms Manufacture, Diabolical Contraption, White House Boss Battles have been rebalanced to be less intimidating and easier to overcome. 
 -	Minor adjustments have been made to the game’s interface during boss battles, improving the general readability of the encounters.

CHALLENGE MISSIONS
We have rebalanced some of the challenge missions to be a little easier to obtain:

 Freeze X Enemies at Once, level: Waltham Arms Manufacture
 Kill X Enemies at Once (P-A Shotgun), level: Waltham Arms Manufacture
 Freeze X Enemies at Once, level: The Big Hunger
 Kill X Enemies at Once (Sharps Rifle), level: The Big Hunger
 Kill X Enemies at Once (Crossbow), level: Abandoned Village
 Kill X Enemies at Once (L-B Shotgun), level: Coy Drake's Mining Company 
 Kill X Enemies at Once (S-O Shotgun), level: Canyon of the Dead (N.R.F.T.L.)
 Kill X Enemies at Once (S-O Shotgun), level: A Frozen Forest

ADDITIONAL GAME BALANCE CHANGES
We have Adjusted the difficulty curve of the game. The initial levels should be better at easing the player in and the latter levels should be more manageable. 
Levels modified:

 Tutorial Part 3
 Tutorial Part 4
 Dimensional Breach
 Iglesia del Santo Pistolero
 Cain MacDowell's Saloon
 A Town Called Bastard
 Vaya con Dios, gringo
 Goodchild Monument
 Trinity Bridge
 The Wicked Burg Train Depot
 Perpetuity Graveyard
 Valley of Delusions
 LaHood's Lumbering Camp
 River of Filth
 Diabolical Contraption
 Coy Drake's Mining Company
 White House

We have modified some enemy attack animations to give the player more time to react:

 Cultist
 Cultist with a spear
 Dog
 Big cultist with a spiked club

LOCALISATION
Minor localisation changes have been made to the game, primarily to German.

                                      But that’s not all of the news.

II. PlayStation 4 launch. Xbox One launch date confirmed
Ritual: Crown of Horns debuts on PlayStation 4 across NA and EU regions today! We can’t wait to see you gunslinging on consoles, so tell your friends and families and jump right in, yeehaw! 
The PlayStation version will be up to date with the Patch 1.0.2 rolling out today on Steam.

The Xbox One version of the game is scheduled to release on March 13th! The game will be available for pre-purchase from March 6th.

Watch the new trailer!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HfyE-Sg6F8c

III. Lossless Soundtrack available 
Finally, we’re updating the Original Soundtrack for Ritual: Crown of Horns, adding .FLAC files to the OST. You will be able to grab it directly from STEAM or, if you don’t own the game yet, bundled.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1179130/Ritual_Crown_of_Horns__OST/

The music composed for the game by Brunon Lubas has been on constant loop in our offices since we first heard it. It’s a mix of metal, folk and who knows what else but it makes one hell of a good soundtrack for basically anything you are doing at the moment!

Again, thank you folks for your support. May your stay in the alternative US in 18XX be a pleasant and gory one! 

-	Draw Distance and Feardemic Teams.

notes.title: Ritual: Crown of Horns has a release date!
notes.notes:
Hi Ritual fans!

We wanted to share some exciting news about RITUAL: CROWN OF HORNS.  We have been working hard behind the scenes to improve the game and given the progress we have made – we would like to announce that the game will go to full release on Thursday NOVEMBER 7th, 2019.

As per our last update from earlier this month, all of the features that we described (with the exception of the Real-World Data Mode, which will be implemented at a later date) will be included in the full release build.

Another exciting development is that for the full release of RITUAL: CROWN OF HORNS we have chosen to work with FEARDEMIC as our publishing partner!

You may not be aware of this, but Bloober Team owns parts of both DRAW DISTANCE S.A and FEARDEMIC – so in some ways we are related. We are enthusiastic to be working together for the first time in an official capacity and hope that it will be the start of a great long-term partnership.

We are really excited about the final build of RITUAL: CROWN OF HORNS and we can’t wait to bring it to you on November 7, 2019 and see first-hand what you think of all the improvements and additions that we have made. We really appreciate the community that have come together around RITUAL and take all input and feedback seriously in an effort to make the game as best we can.

To whet your appetite, we have created a new gameplay and map trailer for you to get the first glimpse at what to expect come November 7th.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mGVJhVITsOs&feature=youtu.be

For more information:
www.feardemic-games.com
www.drawdistance.dev

Best regards,
Jacek @ Draw Distance development team

notes.title: Patch #2: Patch notes for v. 0.6.7.0
notes.notes:
FEATURES:
- IMPORTANT We have reworked our default aiming system for keyboard + mouse. Even though it's not "free", we feel that it's much better than whatever we had before -- our programmer says the game plays better on M+K than on a gamepad right now! Please give it a try and leave us your feedback. Please! :)
- Added missing witch-is-attacked-indicators on levels

- Changed inputs for keyboard:

Now abilities are mapped to Q, E and F
Weapons are mapped to 1, 2 and 3
Also you can use Tab/Mouse Scroll for new weapons

FIXES:
- Nerfed soul gain stat on the superpowers-giving Black And White Cape
- Added "equipped" status icon to elements in inventory
- Fixed a shop-related bug (when you were buying an item and had cash for it, you had an option to buy all other items even if you didn't have cash for them)
- Fixed fonts in inventory UI + made the font on "available blueprints" bigger
- Fixed a bug that blocked the game after pressing ALT+TAB while interacting with NPCs.
- Fixed a bug that made Players invulnerable after receiving hits from sawblades 
- Fixed forced custom loadout on Sawblade-1 that replaced your equipped items with our defaults (sorry!)
- Wisconsin Death Drives ability cooldown reworked
- Disabled camera damping when playing with mouse + keyboard
- Dialogue overlay should fill the entire screen now
- Updated explosive barrel explosion
- Snow-3: more machine animation changes during the level (direction and damping), gameplay should be more fun now!
- Sawblade-1: adjusted saw sizes to match colliders
- Prison-3: more powerups to collect in the level's challenge

notes.title: Patch #1: Patch notes for 6.6.8
notes.notes:
Hey y'all! Here's our first patch that includes some features you've been asking about and some bug fixes :)

Please let us know what you think!

**OFFICIAL PATCH: v. 0.6.6.8**

FEATURES:

Added "free aim" toggle for Keyboard+Mouse, available in options in the Main Menu.
Tweaks to player's animation components in order to make him more responsive while shooting, reloading, and dashing. Overall, control over the player character should feel better now! You can finally change weapons immediately while reloading and so on.
Also, new reloading logic: now weapon reload speed depends on bullets remaining in the chamber.
Added "Inventory" option while interacting with the cart that's taking you to a map in hub for easier access to equipment (first step in our work to successfully remind people that you have to equip things you buy before you can use them)
Changed interactions with powerups: now you can pick up new ones while having other ones active, the new ones will replace the old ones.


FIXES:

Dialogue text fixes on several levels
Exploding Barrels have a bigger and higher collider (should be easier to shoot them)
New challenge on Prison-3 (don't get hurt by darkness instead of kill all enemies)
Fixed colliders on Snow-3, machine shouldn't have any blind spots now
Exploding Barrels on Snow-3 have different colliders for better reactivity
Limited player access to the heart of the machine on Sawblade-3
Some other fixes to machines on Sawblade-3 and Snow-3
